projects.name: Manyar smelter
projects.quote: Construction of the smelter has an estimated cost of $3.0 billion, including $2.8 billion for a construction contract (excluding capitalized interest, owner’s costs and commissioning) and $0.2 billion for investment in a desalinization plant.

projects.name: PT Smelting expansion
projects.quote: PT-FI is funding the cost of the expansion, estimated to approximate $250 million, with a loan that will convert to equity and increase PT-FI’s ownership in PT Smelting to a majority ownership interest, which is expected to occur in 2024.

projects.name: PMR
projects.quote: Construction is in progress with commissioning expected during 2024 at an estimated cost of $575 million, which incorporates recent revisions to scope.

projects.name: Grasberg gas-fired combined cycle facility
projects.quote: PT-FI is planning investments in a new gas-fired combined cycle facility at Grasberg with a targeted start date in 2027.

projects.name: Cerro Verde renewable energy power purchase agreement
projects.quote: Entered into a new renewable energy power purchase agreement in 3Q23
